description: This Java interface defines the LiquibaseProvider, which provides access to Liquibase instances by defining a method to obtain Liquibase objects given a changelog filename. It aims to decouple certain classes and facilitate testing with different databases.

classes.name: LiquibaseProvider
classes.description: A Java interface that supplies Liquibase instances based on provided changelog filenames, promoting decoupling and testability.

methods.name: getLiquibase
methods.description: Returns a Liquibase instance for the specified changelog file, possibly throwing an exception.
